rationale: The current ES 8.8 aggregate Premier Triage and Response row lists Cloud Platform 10.2.x+, ES 8.6+ and paired SOAR. The specific task gives ES 8.7+, enabled AI Assistant, paired SOAR and inherited connector/action/asset permissions. It describes the first-ten limit per detection burst, approximately 200 findings per tenant per day and frontier models. The current workflow wording and historical 8.7 SOC Analyst task remain distinct. The CMP task documents Platform 10.4.x+, ES 8.8+ and Cloud Connect 2.0; the exact indexed setup section gives Cloud Connect 2.0+ and SAIA 2.4+, but its direct URL returns 404. Current SAIA 2.3.6 installation and SAIA-9918 evidence describe 2.4.0 support as planned, so usable CMP workflow is unverified. The November 4 product GA and distinct Essentials, Premier and Cloud Connect region tables do not establish rollout, feature entitlement or authorization.

exclusions: CMP has its separate Platform 10.4+/ES 8.8+/Cloud Connect 2.0 chain; no lower-floor eligibility, tenant rollout, entitlement, pairing or authorization is established.
